fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1D73F70: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 8, ...) then *component = 0xFFC0000000000000 (null EntityHandle). bg3.exe+0x1D6D790 (ecl::TimelineSystem) walks an array of 8-byte elements in its frame data (+0x380, count +0x38C), creates a new event entity for each (FUN_14401AFF0), adds this component and stores the element: '*component = *element'. The macOS index lists ecl::camera::CombatTargetSystem::Update among the readers. Name inferred: the discarded combat timeline's entity.

open_questions: What the handle designates (the discarded combat timeline's entity is assumed); the array at frame data +0x380 was not traced to its writer.
second_pass: Settled on Windows: the creator bg3.exe+0x1D73F70 allocates 8 bytes and writes the null EntityHandle, and bg3.exe+0x1D6D790 copies one 8-byte array element into it per new event entity.
